answer: A concrete approach: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the saffron to sunk effort, uses the cedar as an corroborating signal, then requires a tide before any payout.
